parts.name: Root
parts.description: The checkbox control. It makes a span with role="checkbox", and it keeps a hidden checkbox input correct for the form.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the hidden input, thus a `label[for]` element can point at the checkbox. If you give none, the component makes one.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: name
props.description: The name that the form submits while the checkbox is checked.

props.name: value
props.description: The value that the form submits while the checkbox is checked. It does not change the visual state.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form of the hidden input.

props.name: checked
props.description: The checked state. By default it goes in the two directions: use `bind:checked`.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: The checked state at the start, for when you give no `checked`.

props.name: controlledChecked
props.description:
Give your own code full control of `checked`. The component stops to write back to the prop,
and it reports only through `onCheckedChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change: the parent
does not send the new value down. The default is off, because `bind:checked` is the usual case
and it needs the write-back.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: The indeterminate state. By default it goes in the two directions: use `bind:indeterminate`.

props.name: defaultIndeterminate
props.description: The indeterminate state at the start, for when you give no `indeterminate`.

props.name: controlledIndeterminate
props.description: Give your own code full control of `indeterminate`. Read `controlledChecked`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: The component calls it when the user changes the checked state.

props.name: onIndeterminateChange
props.description: The component calls it when the user changes the indeterminate state. From the indeterminate state, the first user action makes the checkbox checked.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the interaction with the checkbox and removes it from the focus order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the checkbox focusable, but stops the changes of the state.

props.name: required
props.description: Makes the hidden input required for the form validation.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name, for when the user sees no name.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives the checkbox its name.

props.name: tabindex
props.description: Replaces the default position in the tab order.

dataAttributes.name: data-checkbox-input
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the hidden native input.

dataAttributes.name: data-checkbox-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the root element.

dataAttributes.name: data-checked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-indeterminate
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is indeterminate.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer or the keyboard presses the checkbox.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the checkbox is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-unchecked
dataAttributes.description: Present while the checkbox is unchecked.

parts.name: Indicator
parts.description: The check mark or the mixed mark. It is in the DOM only while the checkbox is checked or indeterminate, but `forceMount` keeps it there.

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keeps the indicator in the DOM even while the checkbox is unchecked.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the indicator, usually an icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-checkbox-indicator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the indicator element.
